title: File:Heshun Tengchong - panoramio.jpg
claims: A view over Heshun ancient town near Tengchong: grey tiled rooftops and white walls among green fields, with a wooded hill behind and a cloudy sky; the Shuanghong Bridge finish is not visible in the frame. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Heshun Tengchong - panoramio.jpg. The route page uses it as Heshun ancient-town context for the MGU finish at Shuanghong Bridge; it does not prove the bridge, finish gantry or race-day scene.

The Commons author field reads oldhouse.yin; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); the relevant date is 2011-06-07; the file page gives a camera or subject position of 25.017890 N, 98.453604 E; the original is 2,304 × 1,728 px; 1,831,234 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 720 px; 157,602 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits oldhouse.yin, CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
